responses.message: I recommend the Kenmore espresso machine with grinder and milk frother listed at Kohl’s for $764.99. Its matched page describes a conical burr grinder with 30 settings and a steam wand, covering whole-bean preparation and manual milk steaming. It leaves $35.01 under your equipment limit. I reasonably expect a household package of this kind to include its standard operating accessories and suit US power, although the frozen evidence does not enumerate the accessories or explicitly establish voltage. Expect some practice adjusting the grind and steaming milk, plus routine cleaning; two sequential morning drinks are a reasonable use case.
